Rooms.Name: In the High Grass
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass that reaches up to your knees and
dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would nicely
camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further on to the south 
and to your east lies a small dark cave.

Exits.Description: To your east lies a small dark cave.
You see a single large oak tree standing in the distance.

Rooms.Name: The Cave of Kyre Banorg
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small dark cave and, with skeletons piled up 
in each corner, the stench of death seems to be everywhere. What 
horrible, vile creature could be responsible for this massacre? 
Several astronomical drawings cover the east wall of the cave, glowing 
with a soft blue light. The glow from the drawings gives the cave 
an eerie atmosphere.

Exits.Description: The east wall of the cave is covered with astronomical drawings.
To your west lies the entrance to this cave.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The design of the drawing looks very familiar to you. Several circles
placed inside each other form some kind of elaborate symbol. You
remember reading in an ancient book of wizardry a long time ago. You
remember that this symbol calls upon the ultimate power in the
universe, and is call the "Ultimate Magic Circle of Warding". Only the
gods are able to manipulate this magical power.

Rooms.Name: Along the River bank
Rooms.Description:
A river flows east and south from here. You could either 
follow the river eastwards along the bank or go on the river 
and let the gentle currents carry you south. Dense vegetation 
covers the river bank and the ground beneath your feet feels 
soft making it awkward to move around. A steep rocky wall to 
your west looks impossible to climb.

Exits.Description: The river gently flows south.
The river bank continues south.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
Quietly, the river runs from north to south. On the east side
of the river there is a dense forest and on the west, dense 
vegetation grows. The water is clean and pure, but looking 
downwards, you are unable to see the river bed. Who knows what
kind of creature lurks down there?

Exits.Description: A dense forest covers the east river bank.
The river gently flows south.
Dense vegetation covers the west river bank.
It is too dark down there to make out anything.

Rooms.Name: In the Heavy Woods
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dense forest composed mainly of oak trees.
Lots of leaves have fallen from the trees and lie all over the forest 
floor, although enough remain on the trees to hide a stealthy assailant.
These oak trees are not really very large, but further to the east you 
can make out some truly ancient ones. Through the branches to the west 
you can make out a river, winding its way southwards.

Exits.Description: You can make out some ancient trees to the east.
The river gently continues south.
The river gently flows south.

Rooms.Name: In the Heavy Woods
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dense forest composed mainly of oak trees.
Lots of leaves have fallen from the trees and lie all over the forest 
floor, although enough remain on the trees to hide a stealthy assailant.
The forest continues further to the south and west.

Exits.Description: You can only make out more trees to the south.
You can only make out more trees to the west.
You could hide up in that large oak tree.

dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would nicely 
camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further in every 
direction, and to the south you can see a large oak tree.

Exits.Description: The vast green plain stretches on further to the north.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the east.
A lonely oak tree stands south of you.

Rooms.Name: In the High Grass
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass that reaches up to your knees and
dances gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain would nicely 
camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your foes until they 
practically stepped on you. The plain stretches further to the west,

blocked by a steep rocky outcrop and further to the south is a small

Exits.Description: You see dense vegetation covering a river bank.
A small hill rises south of you.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the west.

Rooms.Name: Along the River Bank
Rooms.Description:
You stop alongside a wide river just to the east, which flows from 
north to south. You can either follow the river or take the plunge and 
swim eastwards, letting the currents take you south. Dense vegetation 
covers both river banks and the ground beneath your feet feels soft 
making it hard to move about. A vast green plain of grass lies to your 
west while to the south a small hill peers down at you.

Exits.Description: The river bank continues north.
The river takes a sharp turn to the east.
A small hill rises south of you.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your west.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The river takes a sharp turn to the east here following around the 
base of a small hill. Dense vegetation covers the west back of the 
river, and on the eastern side you can see a dark forest. Although 
the water is clean and pure, you cannot see very far downwards - who 
knows what might lurk in the depths?

Exits.Description: The river arrives from the north and takes a sharp turn east.
The river continues east around the hill.
A small hill rises south of you.
Dense vegetation covers the west river bank.
It is too dark down there to make out anything.

Rooms.Name: On the River
Rooms.Description:
The river resumes its course south alongside the small hill. East 
of the river is a dark forest, and the west bank is covered by thick 
vegetation. Although the river water is clean and pure, you cannot 
see very far downwards - who knows what might lurk in the depths?

Exits.Description: A dark forest grows on the river bank.
A dark forest grows on the river bank.
The river gently flows south.
The river arrives from the west and continues south.
It is to dark down there to make out anything.

Rooms.Name: In the Heavy Woods
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a dense forest, composed mainly of oak trees. 
The ground beneath your feet is covered by a thick layer of fallen 
leaves, although there are many still on the trees. Although these 
trees are probably too weak to take your weight, there are some 
sturdier looking trees further to the north. To the west, a wide 
river flows south.

Exits.Description: You can make out some ancient trees to the north.
The forest continues south.
The river gently flows south.
You notice a small trapdoor hidden under some leaves.

Rooms.Name: A Lonely Oak
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in high grass, which reaches as high as your 
knees, dancing gracefully in the gentle breeze. This green plain 
would nicely camouflage you and make you almost invisible to your 
foes until they practically stepped on you. The grassy plain 
continues to the north and south, and a small hill lies to the 
east. A big old oak tree stands here completely isolated, and 
would definitely make a nice hiding place for you.

Exits.Description: The vast green plain stretches on further to the north.
A small hill rises east of you.
The vast green plain stretches on further to the south.
You could hide up in that large oak tree.

Rooms.Name: Northwest Side of the Hill
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the northwest side of a small hill. You can 
either climb the hill or walk around it to the east or south. A 
big solitary oak tree stands just west of here, and a wide grassy 
plain spreads out to the north.

Exits.Description: A vast green plain of grass lies to your north.
The hill continues east.
The hill continues south.
A big solitary oak tree stands just west of here.
You see the top of the hill.

Rooms.Name: North Side of the Hill
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the north side of a small hill. You can 
either climb the hill or walk around it to the east or west. A 
little further to the northeast you can see a river flowing gentle 
southwards, and beyond the river is a dark forest.

Exits.Description: Dense vegetation covers the west river bank.
The hill continues east, looks muddy over there.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

Rooms.Name: Northeast Side of the Hill
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the northeast side of a small hill. You can 
either climb the hill or walk around it to the south or west. A 
river flows from the north, around this hill making the ground 
beneath your feel very muddy. Be careful not to fall into the river!

Exits.Description: The river makes a hard turn east just before the hill.
The river gently flows south.
The hill continues south.
The hill continues west.
You see the top of the hill.

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.

A vast green plain of grass lies to your west.

Rooms.Description:

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.

The hill continues west.

Exits.Description: The hill continues north.
The hill continues east.

Rooms.Name: A Bridge over the River
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a bridge that crosses the river. As you lean over 
the side of the bridge and look into the water you are struck by how 
clean and pure the water is. However, the water becomes dark and you are 
unable to see any further than a couple of feet into the depths. The 
bridge supports plunge into the water below you, making a good hiding 
place. On both sides of the bridge a wide grassy plain stretches as far as 
the eye can see.

Exits.Description: Gently the river flows from north to south.
A vast green plain of grass lies to your east.

Rooms.Name: Up in a Large Oak Tree
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a sturdy oak branch, with red and brown leaves
tumbling to the ground as you shuffle about. You can see a river a little
further on to the west meandering from north to south. On the far side
of the river you can see a small hill.

Exits.Description: If you could get that damn branch out of your face you might see something.

Rooms.Name: Up in a Large Oak Tree
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a sturdy oak branch, with red and brown leaves
tumbling to the ground as you shuffle about. There is a small hill 
just to the east, and to the north you notice a little cave.

Exits.Description: If you could get that damn branch out of your face you might see something.

Rooms.Name: The Top of the Hill
Rooms.Description:
As you reach the top of the hill you stop and look around you. Your
eyes wander across the landscape, searching out you foes. You notice
a small cave lying just to the north and looking further eastwards 
a river flows from north to south. As your eyes follow the river south, 
you see a bridge, and on the far side a dense forest. To the west, a
large oak tree stands isolated on a vast green plain.

Exits.Description: You notice a small cave lying just to the north.

You see a river gently flowing from north to south, on the far side is
dense forest.
A bridge over the river lies a little further southeast from the hill.
You only see a large oak tree standing isolated.

Rooms.Name: In the River
Rooms.Description:
You are diving underwater in the river. Long green weeds reach up
from the river bed hiding you from anyone who might be looking for
you in the water.

Exits.Description: Weed, weed, weed, everywhere you look weed.
It's hard to make out anything above the water.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Small Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are crouched inside a cramped dusty tunnel. Dirt rains down from
ceiling as you crawl slowly forward. Roots growing down from above wrap
themselves around your limbs, and get into your eyes. Although low, the 
tunnel is wide enough for two people to pass each other. A small 
trapdoor above your head leads out of the tunnel.

Exits.Description: The tunnel disappears into the darkness.

Rooms.Name: The Nexus
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at a crossroads in time and space. Visions of 
vast green plains, dense forests and a river running alongside a small 
hill fill your mind. You feel as if you exist everywhere at the same
time.

Exits.Description:
As you look north the possibilities of the Nexus rise in your mind you
can travel to vast green plains or a river that runs alongside a small
hill or choose to travel to an ancient oak forrest, that is if you can
control the Nexus.

Mobs.Name: killer rabbit bunny
Mobs.LongDescription: A cute little bunny hops around this place.
Mobs.Description:
The little bunny looks soft and fluffy with long pointy ears, you'd 
like to take it in your arms and hug it tenderly.

Mobs.Name: knight ni
Mobs.LongDescription: The knights who say "Ni!" are standing here.
Mobs.Description:
We are now no longer the Knights who say "Ni!"
We are now the Knights who say "ekky-ekky-ekky-ekky-z'Bang,
zoom-Boing, z'nourrrwringmm".
Therefore we must give you a test.
Firstly, you must find....
                  ANOTHER SHRUBBERY!!!!
THEN...Then, when you have found the shrubbery, you must place
it here, beside this shrubbery, only slightly higher, so we get
the two-level effect with a little path running down the middle.
Then, when you have found the shrubbery, you must cut down the
mightiest tree in the forest...
Wiiiiiiithh....   A HERRING!

Mobs.Name: brother maynard
Mobs.Description:
Armaments, chapter two, versus nine to twenty-one.
"And Saint Atila raised the hand grenade up high,
saying, 'Oh, Lord, bless this thy hand grenade that with it thou
mayest blow thy enemies to tiny bits, in thy mercy.' And the Lord
did grin, and people did feast upon the lambs, and sloths, and carp, 
and anchovies, and orangutans, and breakfast cereals, and fruits bats,
and large ..."
"And the Lord spake, saying, 'First shalt thou take out the Holy Pin.
Then, shalt thou count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the
number thou count, and the number of the counting shalt be three.
Four shalt thou not count, nor either count thou two, excepting that
thou then proceed to three. Five is right out. Once the number three,
being the third number, be reached, then lobbest thou thy Holy Hand
Grenade of Antioch towards thou foe, who being naughty in my sight,
shall snuff it.'"
Amen.
